before.requirement: Unpacking an object member with the string format rejects a selected non-string member.
before.reason: Object-member lookup delegates to the selected value format. The string format rejects a non-string value, but the old harness selects o for the member.

after.requirement: Unpacking an object member with the string format rejects a selected non-string member.
after.reason: The string type check remains available after the change, but the same old harness still selects o for the member.

claims.reason: The same {s?o} member format prevents string type validation before and after the change.
